'''2000 Corellia Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Corellia region (Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, Ohio, Wisconsin) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00corellia">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=corellia 2000 Regionals: Corellia], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726143458/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=corellia Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Brian Fred]] of Lafayette, Indiana won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2000
* '''Site:''' The Game Store (Neutral Ground) Garden City, Michigan
